purpose: Define the build order for turning PJ42 laws and manifests into PJ43 runtime implementation.

build_order.title: Jarvis Manifest Loader
build_order.description: Load PJ42 manifests and validate JSON at startup.

build_order.title: Jarvis Runtime Types
build_order.description: Create TypeScript types for intents, commands, adapters, confidence bands, evidence, approvals, HUD states, and voice states.

build_order.title: Intent Router Runtime
build_order.description: Implement classifier rules, confidence labels, freshness detection, blocked intent detection, and fallback behavior.

build_order.title: Command Registry Runtime
build_order.description: Resolve registered commands and block unknown commands.

build_order.title: Policy Gate Runtime
build_order.description: Enforce Commander-only, approval, memory, evidence, and blocked-action laws.

build_order.title: Tool Router Runtime
build_order.description: Map commands to approved adapters and block unknown tools.

build_order.title: Source Confidence Runtime
build_order.description: Evaluate authority, freshness, evidence, directness, conflicts, and confidence bands.

build_order.title: Knowledge Brain Runtime
build_order.description: Retrieve approved Kingsmen knowledge, exclude forbidden memory, and attach status labels.

build_order.title: Live Data Router Runtime
build_order.description: Route current facts to live web, GitHub, system health, read models, Playwright scout, utilities, or review fallback.

build_order.title: Evidence Ledger Runtime
build_order.description: Record evidence events for answers, tools, approvals, failures, and blocked actions.

build_order.title: Answer Composer Runtime
build_order.description: Compose answers with confidence, evidence, status labels, and next safe action.

build_order.title: Visual HUD Runtime
build_order.description: Render Commander HUD surfaces, cards, drawers, modals, badges, panels, mission board, and mobile view.

build_order.title: Voice-ready Commander Interface Runtime
build_order.description: Implement wake greeting, voice states, speech boundaries, TTS output, and approval-safe voice interaction.

build_order.title: Real Jarvis Kernel Smoke Test
build_order.description: Prove the full flow from Commander message to visual/voice answer with evidence and blocked unsafe paths.
